# BERK Programming Language - Complete API Reference

> This is the full API reference for AI/LLM systems. For a shorter overview, see llms.txt

## Table of Contents

1. [Language Overview](#language-overview)
2. [Complete Keyword Reference](#complete-keyword-reference)
3. [Type System](#type-system)
4. [Standard Library API](#standard-library-api)
5. [AI/ML API](#aiml-api)
6. [HAL API](#hal-api)

---

## Language Overview

BERK is a compiled systems programming language with:
- Bilingual syntax (Turkish keywords have English equivalents)
- Static typing with local type inference
- Result/Option types for error handling
- Pattern matching with exhaustiveness checking
- Zero-cost abstractions
- No garbage collector (ownership-based memory management)

---

## Complete Keyword Reference

### Variable Declarations
```
değişken / var     - Mutable variable
sabit / const      - Constant
```

### Functions
```
işlev / func       - Function definition
geri dön / return  - Return from function
dışa / pub         - Public visibility
```

### Control Flow
```
eğer / if          - Conditional
yoksa / else       - Else branch
eşleş / match      - Pattern matching
eş / match         - Pattern matching (alias)
için / for         - For loop
döngü / for        - For loop (alias)
iken / while       - While loop
piksek / while     - While loop (alias)
kır / break        - Break loop
devam / continue   - Continue loop
```

### Types
```
yapı / struct      - Struct definition
sayım / enum       - Enum definition
tip / type         - Type alias
arayüz / trait     - Trait definition
uygula / impl      - Implementation block
```

### Modules
```
kullan / use       - Import
modül / mod        - Module definition
paket / crate      - Crate reference
```

### Error Handling
```
dene / try         - Try block
yakala / catch     - Catch block
hata / error       - Error
Sonuç / Result     - Result type
Seçenek / Option   - Option type
Tamam / Ok         - Ok variant
Hata / Err         - Err variant
Bazı / Some        - Some variant
Hiç / None         - None variant
```

### Built-in Types
```
Sayı / Number      - Numeric types (i8, i16, i32, i64, u8, u16, u32, u64, f32, f64)
Yazı / String      - UTF-8 string
Bool / Bool        - Boolean (doğru/true, yanlış/false)
karakter / char    - Unicode character
Liste / List       - Dynamic array
Dizi / Array       - Fixed-size array
Demet / Tuple      - Tuple type
```

### Literals
```
doğru / true       - Boolean true
yanlış / false     - Boolean false
boş / null         - Null value
```

### Other Keywords
```
olarak / as        - Type casting
içinde / in        - Iteration
ile / with         - With clause
ve / and           - Logical AND
veya / or          - Logical OR
değil / not        - Logical NOT
öz / self          - Self reference
Öz / Self          - Self type
```

---

## Type System

### Primitive Types
| Type | Size | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `i8` | 1 byte | Signed 8-bit integer |
| `i16` | 2 bytes | Signed 16-bit integer |
| `i32` | 4 bytes | Signed 32-bit integer (default) |
| `i64` | 8 bytes | Signed 64-bit integer |
| `u8` | 1 byte | Unsigned 8-bit integer |
| `u16` | 2 bytes | Unsigned 16-bit integer |
| `u32` | 4 bytes | Unsigned 32-bit integer |
| `u64` | 8 bytes | Unsigned 64-bit integer |
| `f32` | 4 bytes | 32-bit floating point |
| `f64` | 8 bytes | 64-bit floating point (default) |
| `bool` | 1 byte | Boolean |
| `char` | 4 bytes | Unicode scalar value |

### Compound Types
```berk
// Array (fixed size)
var arr: [i32; 5] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

// List (dynamic)
var list: List<i32> = List.new()

// Tuple
var tuple: (i32, String, bool) = (42, "hello", true)

// Struct
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64
}

// Enum
enum Color {
    Red,
    Green,
    Blue,
    Rgb(u8, u8, u8)
}
```

### Generic Types
```berk
func identity<T>(value: T) -> T {
    return value
}

struct Container<T> {
    value: T
}
```

## Standard Library API

### io Module
```berk
use io

// Print to stdout
io.print(value: any) -> ()
io.println(value: any) -> ()

// Read from stdin
io.read_line() -> Result<String, Error>
io.read_char() -> Result<char, Error>

// Formatted output
io.printf(format: String, args: ...) -> ()
```

### fs Module
```berk
use fs

// File operations
fs.read(path: String) -> Result<String, Error>
fs.read_bytes(path: String) -> Result<List<u8>, Error>
fs.write(path: String, content: String) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.write_bytes(path: String, data: List<u8>) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.append(path: String, content: String) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.delete(path: String) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.exists(path: String) -> bool
fs.copy(src: String, dst: String) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.rename(old: String, new: String) -> Result<(), Error>

// Directory operations
fs.mkdir(path: String) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.mkdir_all(path: String) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.rmdir(path: String) -> Result<(), Error>
fs.list_dir(path: String) -> Result<List<String>, Error>
```

### string Module
```berk
use string

// String methods (also available on String type)
String.len() -> usize
String.is_empty() -> bool
String.contains(s: String) -> bool
String.starts_with(s: String) -> bool
String.ends_with(s: String) -> bool
String.trim() -> String
String.trim_start() -> String
String.trim_end() -> String
String.to_uppercase() -> String
String.to_lowercase() -> String
String.replace(from: String, to: String) -> String
String.split(sep: String) -> List<String>
String.chars() -> List<char>
String.bytes() -> List<u8>
String.substring(start: usize, end: usize) -> String
String.parse<T>() -> Result<T, Error>
```

### collections Module
```berk
use collections

// HashMap
HashMap<K, V>.new() -> HashMap<K, V>
HashMap.insert(key: K, value: V) -> Option<V>
HashMap.get(key: K) -> Option<V>
HashMap.remove(key: K) -> Option<V>
HashMap.contains_key(key: K) -> bool
HashMap.len() -> usize
HashMap.is_empty() -> bool
HashMap.keys() -> List<K>
HashMap.values() -> List<V>
HashMap.iter() -> Iterator<(K, V)>

// HashSet
HashSet<T>.new() -> HashSet<T>
HashSet.insert(value: T) -> bool
HashSet.remove(value: T) -> bool
HashSet.contains(value: T) -> bool
HashSet.len() -> usize
HashSet.is_empty() -> bool
HashSet.iter() -> Iterator<T>
HashSet.union(other: HashSet<T>) -> HashSet<T>
HashSet.intersection(other: HashSet<T>) -> HashSet<T>
```

```berk
math.exp(x: f64) -> f64
math.log(x: f64) -> f64

math.log2(x: f64) -> f64
math.sin(x: f64) -> f64
math.cos(x: f64) -> f64
math.tan(x: f64) -> f64
math.asin(x: f64) -> f64
math.acos(x: f64) -> f64

math.atan2(y: f64, x: f64) -> f64

math.ceil(x: f64) -> f64

math.min(a: Number, b: Number) -> Number

```

### time Module
```berk
use time

// Current time
time.now() -> DateTime
time.timestamp() -> i64
time.timestamp_millis() -> i64

// DateTime
DateTime.year() -> i32
DateTime.month() -> u32
DateTime.day() -> u32
DateTime.hour() -> u32
DateTime.minute() -> u32
DateTime.second() -> u32
DateTime.format(fmt: String) -> String
DateTime.add_days(days: i64) -> DateTime
DateTime.add_hours(hours: i64) -> DateTime

// Duration
Duration.from_secs(secs: u64) -> Duration
Duration.from_millis(millis: u64) -> Duration
Duration.as_secs() -> u64
Duration.as_millis() -> u64

// Sleep
time.sleep(duration: Duration) -> ()
time.sleep_ms(ms: u64) -> ()
time.sleep_secs(secs: u64) -> ()
```

### thread Module
```berk
use thread

// Thread creation
thread.spawn(f: fn() -> T) -> JoinHandle<T>
JoinHandle.join() -> Result<T, Error>

// Thread operations
thread.current() -> Thread
thread.sleep(duration: Duration) -> ()
thread.yield_now() -> ()

// Mutex
Mutex<T>.new(value: T) -> Mutex<T>
Mutex.lock() -> MutexGuard<T>
Mutex.try_lock() -> Option<MutexGuard<T>>

// Channel
channel<T>() -> (Sender<T>, Receiver<T>)
Sender.send(value: T) -> Result<(), Error>
Receiver.recv() -> Result<T, Error>
Receiver.try_recv() -> Option<T>
```

### async Module
```berk
use async

// Async runtime
async.run(future: Future<T>) -> T
async.spawn(future: Future<T>) -> Task<T>
Task.await() -> T

// Async functions
async func fetch_data() -> Result<String, Error> {
    // ...
}

// Await
var result = fetch_data().await?
```

### http Module
```berk
use http

// HTTP Client
http.get(url: String) -> Result<Response, Error>
http.post(url: String, body: String) -> Result<Response, Error>
http.put(url: String, body: String) -> Result<Response, Error>
http.delete(url: String) -> Result<Response, Error>

// Response
Response.status() -> u16
Response.headers() -> HashMap<String, String>
Response.text() -> Result<String, Error>
Response.json<T>() -> Result<T, Error>
Response.bytes() -> Result<List<u8>, Error>

// HTTP Server
Server.new(addr: String) -> Server
Server.route(path: String, handler: fn(Request) -> Response) -> ()
Server.start() -> Result<(), Error>

// Request
Request.method() -> String
Request.path() -> String
Request.headers() -> HashMap<String, String>
Request.body() -> String
Request.query(key: String) -> Option<String>

// Response builder
Response.ok(body: String) -> Response
Response.json(data: any) -> Response
Response.status(code: u16) -> Response
Response.header(key: String, value: String) -> Response
```

### json Module
```berk
use json

// Parsing
json.parse(s: String) -> Result<Value, Error>
json.parse_as<T>(s: String) -> Result<T, Error>

// Serialization
json.stringify(value: any) -> Result<String, Error>
json.stringify_pretty(value: any) -> Result<String, Error>

// Value type
Value.is_null() -> bool
Value.is_bool() -> bool
Value.is_number() -> bool
Value.is_string() -> bool
Value.is_array() -> bool
Value.is_object() -> bool
Value.as_bool() -> Option<bool>
Value.as_i64() -> Option<i64>
Value.as_f64() -> Option<f64>
Value.as_str() -> Option<String>
Value.as_array() -> Option<List<Value>>
Value.as_object() -> Option<HashMap<String, Value>>
Value[key: String] -> Value
Value[index: usize] -> Value
```

### regex Module
```berk
use regex

// Regex
Regex.new(pattern: String) -> Result<Regex, Error>
Regex.is_match(text: String) -> bool
Regex.find(text: String) -> Option<Match>
Regex.find_all(text: String) -> List<Match>
Regex.replace(text: String, replacement: String) -> String
Regex.replace_all(text: String, replacement: String) -> String
Regex.captures(text: String) -> Option<Captures>

// Match
Match.start() -> usize
Match.end() -> usize
Match.as_str() -> String
```

### crypto Module
```berk
use crypto

// Hashing
crypto.sha256(data: List<u8>) -> List<u8>
crypto.sha512(data: List<u8>) -> List<u8>
crypto.md5(data: List<u8>) -> List<u8>
crypto.blake3(data: List<u8>) -> List<u8>

// HMAC
crypto.hmac_sha256(key: List<u8>, data: List<u8>) -> List<u8>

// Random
crypto.random_bytes(len: usize) -> List<u8>

// Encoding
crypto.base64_encode(data: List<u8>) -> String
crypto.base64_decode(s: String) -> Result<List<u8>, Error>
crypto.hex_encode(data: List<u8>) -> String
crypto.hex_decode(s: String) -> Result<List<u8>, Error>
```

## AI/ML API

### ai.tensor Module
```berk
use ai.tensor

// Tensor creation
Tensor.new(data: List<List<f32>>) -> Tensor
Tensor.zeros(shape: List<usize>) -> Tensor
Tensor.ones(shape: List<usize>) -> Tensor
Tensor.rand(shape: List<usize>) -> Tensor
Tensor.randn(shape: List<usize>) -> Tensor
Tensor.from_list(data: List<f32>, shape: List<usize>) -> Tensor

// Tensor properties
Tensor.shape() -> List<usize>
Tensor.ndim() -> usize
Tensor.size() -> usize
Tensor.dtype() -> DType

// Tensor operations
Tensor.add(other: Tensor) -> Tensor
Tensor.sub(other: Tensor) -> Tensor
Tensor.mul(other: Tensor) -> Tensor
Tensor.div(other: Tensor) -> Tensor
Tensor.matmul(other: Tensor) -> Tensor
Tensor.transpose() -> Tensor
Tensor.reshape(shape: List<usize>) -> Tensor
Tensor.flatten() -> Tensor
Tensor.sum() -> Tensor
Tensor.mean() -> Tensor
Tensor.max() -> Tensor
Tensor.min() -> Tensor
Tensor.softmax(dim: i32) -> Tensor
Tensor.relu() -> Tensor
Tensor.sigmoid() -> Tensor
Tensor.tanh() -> Tensor

// Gradients
Tensor.requires_grad(flag: bool) -> Tensor
Tensor.backward() -> ()
Tensor.grad() -> Option<Tensor>
```

### ai.nn Module
```berk
use ai.nn

// Layers
nn.Linear(in_features: usize, out_features: usize) -> Linear
nn.Conv2d(in_ch: usize, out_ch: usize, kernel: usize) -> Conv2d
nn.BatchNorm1d(features: usize) -> BatchNorm1d
nn.BatchNorm2d(features: usize) -> BatchNorm2d
nn.Dropout(p: f32) -> Dropout
nn.Embedding(num: usize, dim: usize) -> Embedding
nn.LSTM(input: usize, hidden: usize) -> LSTM
nn.GRU(input: usize, hidden: usize) -> GRU
nn.Transformer(d_model: usize, nhead: usize) -> Transformer

// Activations
nn.ReLU() -> ReLU
nn.Sigmoid() -> Sigmoid
nn.Tanh() -> Tanh
nn.Softmax(dim: i32) -> Softmax
nn.GELU() -> GELU
nn.LeakyReLU(slope: f32) -> LeakyReLU

// Containers
nn.Sequential(layers: List<Layer>) -> Sequential
Sequential.forward(input: Tensor) -> Tensor
Sequential.parameters() -> List<Tensor>

// Loss functions
nn.MSELoss() -> MSELoss
nn.CrossEntropyLoss() -> CrossEntropyLoss
nn.BCELoss() -> BCELoss
nn.L1Loss() -> L1Loss
```

### ai.optim Module
```berk
use ai.optim

// Optimizers
optim.SGD(params: List<Tensor>, lr: f32) -> SGD
optim.Adam(params: List<Tensor>, lr: f32) -> Adam
optim.AdamW(params: List<Tensor>, lr: f32) -> AdamW
optim.RMSprop(params: List<Tensor>, lr: f32) -> RMSprop

// Optimizer methods
Optimizer.step() -> ()
Optimizer.zero_grad() -> ()

// Learning rate schedulers
optim.StepLR(optimizer: Optimizer, step_size: usize) -> StepLR
optim.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer: Optimizer, T_max: usize) -> CosineAnnealingLR
Scheduler.step() -> ()
```

### ai.train Module
```berk
use ai.train

// Training loop utilities
train.train_epoch(model: Module, loader: DataLoader, optimizer: Optimizer, loss_fn: Loss) -> f32
train.evaluate(model: Module, loader: DataLoader, loss_fn: Loss) -> f32

// DataLoader
DataLoader.new(dataset: Dataset, batch_size: usize, shuffle: bool) -> DataLoader
DataLoader.iter() -> Iterator<(Tensor, Tensor)>

// Checkpointing
train.save_checkpoint(model: Module, path: String) -> Result<(), Error>
train.load_checkpoint(model: Module, path: String) -> Result<(), Error>
```

## HAL API

### hal.gpio Module
```berk
use hal.gpio

// Pin modes
enum Mode {
    Input,
    Output,
    InputPullUp,
    InputPullDown,
    OutputOpenDrain,
    Analog,
    Alternate(u8)
}

// Pin configuration
Pin.new(port: char, pin: u8, mode: Mode) -> Pin
Pin.set_mode(mode: Mode) -> ()

// Digital I/O
Pin.high() -> ()
Pin.low() -> ()
Pin.toggle() -> ()
Pin.read() -> bool
Pin.write(value: bool) -> ()

// Interrupts
Pin.set_interrupt(edge: Edge, callback: fn()) -> ()
enum Edge { Rising, Falling, Both }
```

### hal.timer Module
```berk
use hal.timer

// Timer configuration
Timer.new(id: u8) -> Timer
Timer.set_frequency(hz: u32) -> ()
Timer.set_period(ms: u32) -> ()

// Timer control
Timer.start() -> ()
Timer.stop() -> ()
Timer.reset() -> ()
Timer.count() -> u32

// Delay functions
timer.delay_us(us: u32) -> ()
timer.delay_ms(ms: u32) -> ()
timer.delay_s(s: u32) -> ()

// Callbacks
Timer.set_callback(callback: fn()) -> ()
```

### hal.usart Module
```berk
use hal.usart

// USART configuration
Usart.new(id: u8, baud: u32) -> Usart
Usart.set_baud(baud: u32) -> ()
Usart.set_parity(parity: Parity) -> ()
Usart.set_stop_bits(bits: StopBits) -> ()

// Communication
Usart.write(data: List<u8>) -> Result<(), Error>
Usart.write_str(s: String) -> Result<(), Error>
Usart.read() -> Result<u8, Error>
Usart.read_line() -> Result<String, Error>
Usart.available() -> usize

enum Parity { None, Even, Odd }
enum StopBits { One, Two }
```

### hal.spi Module
```berk
use hal.spi

// SPI configuration
Spi.new(id: u8) -> Spi
Spi.set_clock(hz: u32) -> ()
Spi.set_mode(mode: SpiMode) -> ()

// Communication
Spi.transfer(data: List<u8>) -> Result<List<u8>, Error>
Spi.write(data: List<u8>) -> Result<(), Error>
Spi.read(len: usize) -> Result<List<u8>, Error>

enum SpiMode { Mode0, Mode1, Mode2, Mode3 }
```

### hal.i2c Module
```berk
use hal.i2c

// I2C configuration
I2c.new(id: u8) -> I2c
I2c.set_speed(speed: I2cSpeed) -> ()

// Communication
I2c.write(addr: u8, data: List<u8>) -> Result<(), Error>
I2c.read(addr: u8, len: usize) -> Result<List<u8>, Error>
I2c.write_read(addr: u8, write: List<u8>, read_len: usize) -> Result<List<u8>, Error>
I2c.scan() -> List<u8>

enum I2cSpeed { Standard, Fast, FastPlus }
```

### hal.adc Module
```berk
use hal.adc

// ADC configuration
Adc.new(id: u8) -> Adc
Adc.set_resolution(bits: u8) -> ()
Adc.set_sample_time(time: SampleTime) -> ()

// Reading
Adc.read(channel: u8) -> u16
Adc.read_voltage(channel: u8, vref: f32) -> f32

enum SampleTime { Cycles3, Cycles15, Cycles28, Cycles56, Cycles84 }
```

### hal.pwm Module
```berk
use hal.pwm

// PWM configuration
Pwm.new(timer: u8, channel: u8) -> Pwm
Pwm.set_frequency(hz: u32) -> ()

Pwm.set_duty_raw(value: u16) -> ()

Pwm.disable() -> ()
```

---

## Error Messages

Common error messages and their meanings:

| Error Code | Message | Meaning |
|------------|---------|---------|
| E0001 | Type mismatch | Expected type does not match actual type |
| E0002 | Undefined variable | Variable not declared in scope |
| E0003 | Undefined function | Function not found |
| E0004 | Argument count mismatch | Wrong number of arguments |
| E0005 | Cannot borrow | Borrow checker violation |
| E0006 | Use after move | Value used after being moved |
| E0007 | Module not found | Import path invalid |
| E0008 | Pattern not exhaustive | Match missing cases |
| E0009 | Division by zero | Runtime division by zero |
| E0010 | Index out of bounds | Array/list access out of range |
